title: Character expectation as a root probability
statement: Let $n,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell>0$, choose an irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$, and let $\gamma$ be any binary vector of length $n$. The expected Walsh character of the generated output, when both length-$\ell$ seeds are chosen uniformly, equals $2^{-\ell}$ times the number of length-$\ell$ binary vectors $r$ for which $\sum_{i=0}^{n-1}\gamma_i r^{i+1}=0$ in the binary field defined by the modulus.
hypotheses_covered: The implementation has an irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$
$\gamma$ is a binary vector of length $n$
